purpose: Section 20: a FRESH, pre-frozen holdout sample - zero overlap with the original 65-case sample (07) - to re-test REPLACEMENT_RUBRIC_V2 (the two precisionClarifications in _taxonomy-operational-rubric-v2-REPLACEMENT.json) with the same independent-adjudication methodology, per the phase's requirement that a replacement ontology/rubric never be validated on the same data that produced the confusion evidence motivating it.

methodology.eligiblePool: All 1,050 ground-truth units NOT in the original 65-case frozenCaseIds list, drawn from the same zero-cost deterministic manifest used to build the original sample.
methodology.targetedComponent_chapeau: Up to 6 per dataset of the remaining chapeau-shaped units (isChapeauShape=true) not already used - the exact structural shape the dominant confusion cluster concentrated in. Only 2 datasets (dsgr, conmed) have any chapeau-shaped units remaining after the original sample's selection exhausted 19 of the corpus's 33 total chapeau-shaped units; 5 of the 6 selected here are from doc-a/doc-b (dsgr).
methodology.targetedComponent_siblingAdjacency: Up to 4 per dataset of remaining non-chapeau UNREPRESENTED units with siblingCount >= 2 - the fwrg-6.06-b-ii-style mechanism (a candidate anchored at a different sibling sub-item, not the claim's own).
methodology.generalDiversityFill: Up to 2 additional NOT-yet-selected cases per remaining non-empty stratum (1-5, 8, 10-19), to confirm the rubric clarification does not regress reproducibility elsewhere in the taxonomy, using the same materiality-then-id tie-break as the original sample.
methodology.scarcityDisclosure: Chapeau-shaped claims are architecturally rare (33 total across all 1,115 ground-truth units in the 4 frozen datasets - roughly one per major covenant section). The original 65-case sample already used 19 of them (including all 14 false-credit controls, which are themselves chapeau-shaped). This holdout captures the large majority of what remains (6 of ~14-16 remaining), which is the maximum honest test of the exact confirmed mechanism the population supports without exhausting the corpus entirely.
methodology.reproducibilityOfSelection: Selection script preserved at docs/evaluation-v2-final-resolution/_holdout-sample-build-script.py; deterministic (fixed sort keys, no randomness), reproducible against the frozen manifest and the original 65-case exclusion set.

sampleComposition.strataNotRepresentedDisclosure: Stratum 6 (unsupported/silent) had only 1 case system-wide and it was already used in the original sample. Strata 7 (ambiguous) and 9 (exact verified) remain structurally empty across the entire corpus (see 07/13/14's disclosures) - no case exists to sample for either, in the holdout or anywhere else.

nextStep: Build a BLINDED evidence packet (same schema/discipline as _frozen-sample-packets-BLINDED-v3.json, V2 disposition fields stripped) for these 22 cases, and a corresponding SEALED labels file. Dispatch the same three independent, mutually-isolated adjudicators against REPLACEMENT_RUBRIC_V2 (_taxonomy-operational-rubric-v2-REPLACEMENT.json) and this holdout. Both reproducibility gates (binary >=90%, detailed >=85%) must pass on this holdout before any V2-vs-consensus comparison may proceed.
